Problem 24

The Japanese honey bee (ニホンミツバチ) is known to have a mechanism for communicating to other bees the direction of a feeding site, recognised with the position of the sun as reference. A worker bee that has found a feeding site, on returning to the hive, performs a figure-of-eight dance on the surface of the comb, which stands vertical to the ground. The angle between the direction of the straight run in the middle of the figure-of-eight dance and the vertical upward direction indicates the angle between the direction of the feeding site and the direction of the sun, as seen from the hive. In addition, the speed of the dance reflects the distance from the hive to the feeding site.

On a certain sunny day of the autumn equinox, Japanese honey bees A, B and C performed the figure-of-eight dances, with their numbers of turns, shown in Figure 24-1. Choose only one of (1)–(8) as the combination that best fits which flowers' nectar each individual had collected, and mark the corresponding number in the answer box. Answer box: 43

problems.title: Problem 25
problems.problem:
Problem 25

In the mating behaviour of the medaka (メダカ), the male first approaches the female and performs a courtship dance in front of her. If the female likes him, they then cross (come into close contact) and release eggs and sperm, and external fertilisation takes place. So what kind of male does the female accept? Medaka show mating behaviour every morning if they are kept at around 28 °C. Therefore one heater was provided, a tank system circulating this water (28 °C) (circulating type) was made so that there was no difference in temperature between the tanks, and the following experiments were carried out (the laboratory was kept at 25 °C).

Experiment 1: One male and one female were put in the same tank and kept (control experiment).

Experiment 2: From the day before the experiment, one male was put in a tall glass Petri dish, which was placed in the tank containing one female, and they were kept like this. On the morning of the experiment day, the male was taken out of the glass Petri dish and put in the same tank as the female.

Experiment 3: The male was hidden with black paper, placed in a tall Petri dish and kept outside the circulating tank system. The next morning, the male was taken out of the glass Petri dish and put in the same tank as the female.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/jbo-2020-2-25-fig1.png

Figure labels (Japanese → English): 循環式 = circulating type; 循環していない = not circulating; 実験2 = Experiment 2; 実験3 = Experiment 3.

Figure 25-1. Experiments on the mating behaviour of medaka

As a result, in Experiments 1 and 2 the female accepted the male immediately. In Experiment 3, the time taken before the male was accepted was longer than in Experiments 1 and 2.

Judge whether each of the statements (1)–(3) below is true or false, and mark all the options that can be judged possible from the experimental results above. If you judge that all the statements are correct, mark only (9); if you judge that there is no correct statement, mark only (0). Answer box: 44

(1) Females accept more quickly a male that they have been seeing since the previous day.

(2) Females perform mating behaviour only with a male that they have been seeing since the previous day.

(3) The mating behaviour of males is temperature-dependent.

第25問

メダカの配偶行動では、まずオスがメスに接近し、メスの前で求愛演舞を行う。メスが気に入れば、その後交叉（密着）し、放卵、放精して体外受精が成立する。では、メスはどのようなオスを受け入れるのだろうか。メダカは28 ℃前後で飼育していれば毎朝配偶行動をとる。そこでヒーターを1つ用意して、この水（28 ℃）を循環させる水槽（循環式）を作り、水槽の間で温度の差がないようにし、以下の実験を行った（実験室内は25 ℃にした）。

実験1: オス1匹とメス1匹を、同じ水槽に入れて、飼育（対照実験）。

実験2: 実験を行う前日から、オス1匹を背の高いガラスシャーレに入れて、これをメス1匹が入った水槽に入れて飼育した。実験日の朝、オスをガラスシャーレから出して、メスと同じ水槽に入れた。

実験3: オスを黒い紙で隠して、背の高いシャーレに置いて、循環式水槽の外で飼育した。翌朝、オスをガラスシャーレから出して、メスと同じ水槽に入れた。

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/jbo-2020-2-25-fig1.png

図25-1. メダカの配偶行動実験

その結果、実験1と2ではすぐにメスがオスをすぐに受け入れた。実験3ではオスを受け入れるまでの時間が実験1、2と比べて多くかかった。

以下の(1)-(3)の記述の正誤を判定し、上記の実験結果から、可能性があると判断できる選択肢を全てマークしなさい。なお、全ての記述が正しいと判断した場合は(9)だけをマークし、正しい記述が無いと判断した場合は(0)だけをマークしなさい。解答欄は 44

(1) メスは前日から視認していたオスを早く受け入れる。

(2) メスは前日から視認しているオスにしか配偶行動を行なわない。

(3) オスの配偶行動は温度依存的である。

problems.title: Problem 26
problems.problem:
Problem 26

Connell (1961) reported that, in the intertidal zone of Scotland, there is competition for attachment sites between two species of barnacles, *Chthamalus stellatus* and *Balanus balanoides* (now *Semibalanus balanoides*). In the intertidal zone of the southern Oshima region of Hokkaido, the rock barnacle (イワフジツボ) and the purple mussel (ムラサキインコガイ) are known to be in a similar relationship (Takahashi 2007). The rock barnacle and the purple mussel are sessile animals living in the intertidal zone; normally the rock barnacle lives in colonies in the upper part of the intertidal zone and the purple mussel in the middle part. To test interspecific competition between the two species, a plot from which the rock barnacles were removed (plot A) and a plot from which the purple mussels were removed (plot B) were made, and how the distributions of the two species would become in the removal plots was simulated.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/jbo-2020-2-26-fig1.png

Figure labels (Japanese → English): 潮位 (cm) = tide level (cm); 対象区 = control plot; A区 = plot A; B区 = plot B; イワフジツボ = rock barnacle; ムラサキインコガイ = purple mussel; 高潮線（約150 cm） = high-tide line (about 150 cm); 潮間帯 = intertidal zone; 低潮線（0 cm） = low-tide line (0 cm); 潮下帯 = subtidal zone.

Figure 26-1. Schematic diagram of the distribution patterns of the two species in the control plot (対象区) and in plot A (rock barnacles removed) and plot B (purple mussels removed). In the control plot, the rock barnacle and the purple mussel are never distributed overlapping each other. The high-tide line shows the height when the tide is highest, and the low-tide line the height when the tide is lowest. Taking the low-tide line as 0 cm, the zone between the low-tide line and the high-tide line is called the intertidal zone, and the zone below the low-tide line the subtidal zone.

Question 1

Figure 26-1 shows the results of the simulation. Mark all the numbers of the options judged to be correct as statements that can be inferred from Figure 26-1. If you judge that all the statements are correct, mark only (9); if you judge that there is no correct statement, mark only (0). Answer box: 45

(1) The rock barnacle and the purple mussel are always in a competitive relationship.

(2) The upper limit of the distribution of the purple mussel is restricted by the tides.

(3) The purple mussel is stronger than the rock barnacle in competition in the middle part of the intertidal zone.

(4) The greatest factor restricting the distribution of the rock barnacle is food.

Question 2

On natural shores, things do not necessarily turn out as in the simulation, and species in a competitive relationship coexist without being excluded. Of the following statements about factors by which interspecific competition between the rock barnacle and the purple mussel is relaxed on natural shores, mark all the numbers of the options judged to be correct. If you judge that all the statements are correct, mark only (9); if you judge that there is no correct statement, mark only (0). Answer box: 46

(1) Competition is relaxed when the plankton that are food for the rock barnacle and the purple mussel are abundant.

(2) Competition is relaxed when other sessile organisms, such as seaweeds and sponges, are present in the same place.

(3) Competition is relaxed when predators of the rock barnacle and the purple mussel, such as carnivorous snails and starfish, are present.

(4) Competition is relaxed when there is moderate disturbance, such as being torn off by waves.

第26問

Connell (1961)は、スコットランドの潮間帯において、*Chthamalus stellatus*と*Balanus balanoides*（現*Semibalanus balanoides*）の2種類のフジツボの間に、付着場所を巡る競争があることを報告した。北海道道南地方の潮間帯ではイワフジツボとムラサキインコガイが似たような関係にあることが知られている（高橋2007）。イワフジツボとムラサキインコガイは潮間帯に生息する固着性動物で、通常イワフジツボは潮間帯の上部、ムラサキインコガイは中部に群生する。2種の種間競争を検証するため、イワフジツボを除去した区画（A区）と、ムラサキインコガイを除去した区画（B区）を作り、除去区において2種の分布がどのようになるかをシミュレーションした。

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/jbo-2020-2-26-fig1.png

図26-1. 対象区とA区（イワフジツボ除去区）、B区（ムラサキインコガイ除去区）における2種の分布パターンの模式図。対象区においてイワフジツボとムラサキインコガイが重なり合って分布することはない。高潮線は潮が最も満ちた時の高さ、低潮線は潮が最も引いた時の高さを示している。低潮線を0 cmとして、低潮線と高潮線との間を潮間帯、低潮線より下を潮下帯と呼んでいる。

問1

図26-1はシミュレーションの結果を示したものである。図26-1から推測できる記述として正しいと判断される選択肢の番号を全てマークしなさい。なお、全ての記述が正しいと判断した場合は(9)だけをマークし、正しい記述が無いと判断した場合は(0)だけをマークしなさい。解答欄は 45

(1) イワフジツボとムラサキインコガイは常に競争関係にある。

(2) ムラサキインコガイの分布の上限は潮汐による制限を受けている。

(3) ムラサキインコガイは潮間帯中部の競争においてイワフジツボよりも強い。

(4) イワフジツボの分布を制限している最大の要因は食物である。

問2

自然海岸では必ずしもシミュレーション通りにはならず、競争関係にある種が排除されることなく共存している。自然海岸においてイワフジツボとムラサキインコガイの種間競争が緩和される要因に関する以下の記述のうち、正しいと判断される選択肢の番号を全てマークしなさい。なお、全ての記述が正しいと判断した場合は(9)だけをマークし、正しい記述が無いと判断した場合は(0)だけをマークしなさい。解答欄は 46

(1) イワフジツボやムラサキインコガイの餌となるプランクトンが豊富にある場合は競争が緩和される。

(2) 海藻や海綿など、同所に他の固着性生物が存在する場合は競争が緩和される。

(3) 肉食性の貝、ヒトデなど、イワフジツボやムラサキインコガイに対する捕食者が存在する場合は競争が緩和される。

(4) 波浪によってはがされるなどの適度な攪乱がある場合は競争が緩和される。

生物多様性のとらえ方の1つに種の多様性（種多様性）がある。種多様性は、種数だけでなく、各種の出現する割合も基準となる。また、種多様性で重要なことは、それが空間のスケールに依存するという点である。種数‐面積曲線は、種多様性を評価する方法の1つで、1つの調査区（単位面積の方形区）を基準として、面積を拡大していき、調査区の面積とその調査区中に存在する種数との関係を表した曲線である。図30-1は特徴の異なる2つの種数‐面積曲線で、cは単位面積あたりの種数を示している。図30-2は生息地全体と小区画での種多様性の関係を示した模式図で、(a)と(b)は図30-1の(ア)と(イ)のいずれかにそれぞれ対応するものとする。これらの図について述べた①～⑥の記述について、正しいものの組合せを(1)-(8)からひとつだけ選び、該当する番号を解答欄にマークしなさい。解答欄は 60

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/jbo-2020-2-30-fig1.png

図30-1. 特徴の異なる2つの種数-面積曲線

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/jbo-2020-2-30-fig2.png

図30-2. 生息地全体と小区画での種多様性の関係を示した模式図

① (ア)には(a)が、(イ)には(b)が対応する。

② (ア)には(b)が、(イ)には(a)が対応する。

③ 生息地全体の種多様性が高いのは(a)である。

④ 生息地全体の種多様性が高いのは(b)である。

⑤ 生物多様性の保全対策を考える場合、より広い地域を保全することが必要な調査区は(ア)である。

⑥ 生物多様性の保全対策を考える場合、より広い地域を保全することが必要な調査区は(イ)である。

(1) ①③⑤　(2) ①③⑥　(3) ①④⑤　(4) ①④⑥　(5) ②③⑤

(6) ②③⑥　(7) ②④⑤　(8) ②④⑥

A culture of Escherichia coli (大腸菌) grown asynchronously in a medium containing sufficient nutrients for growth was divided into two, called culture P and culture Q. A DNA ligase inhibitor was added to culture Q only; 70 minutes later, DNA was extracted from culture P and culture Q and made single-stranded by alkali treatment. problems.problem:
Drug-resistant strains exist in a certain bacterium (eubacterium). To find out the rate of occurrence (mutation rate) of the mutation by which an individual that is not resistant to a certain drug changes into a resistant individual, the following experiment was carried out.

One non-resistant individual was cultured synchronously, and $2^{15} = 32768$ individuals were obtained in 15 division cycles. Synchronous culture is culture in which the timing of cell division is aligned, and the number of individuals doubles as 2, 4, 8, …. Among the 32768 individuals, the number of individuals resistant to the drug was examined. This experiment was carried out 100 times; in 3 of the 100 experiments, individuals resistant to the drug were detected. The numbers of such individuals were 1, 2 and 12, respectively.

Assuming that the mutation rate is low and that back mutations (mutations by which a resistant individual changes into a non-resistant one) do not occur, and further that lethal mutations and mutations that make division asynchronous do not occur, choose from A–L the formula that estimates the mutation rate per cell division (the total number of mutations divided by the total number of cell divisions). (5 points)

A. 3 ÷ (32768 × 100)

B. 3 ÷ (32767 × 100)

C. 3 ÷ (15 × 100)

D. 4 ÷ (32768 × 100)

E. 4 ÷ (32767 × 100)

F. 4 ÷ (15 × 100)

G. 5 ÷ (32768 × 100)

H. 5 ÷ (32767 × 100)

I. 5 ÷ (15 × 100)

J. 15 ÷ (32768 × 100)

K. 15 ÷ (32767 × 100)

L. 15 ÷ (15 × 100)
problems.problem_orig:
ある細菌（真正細菌）には薬剤耐性菌が存在する。ある薬剤に耐性のない個体が耐性のある個体に変化する突然変異の出現率（突然変異率）を知るために，次のような実験を行った。

耐性のない1個体を同調培養し，15回の分裂サイクルで$2^{15} = 32768$個体をえた。なお，同調培養とは，細胞分裂の時期をそろえる培養であり，個体数は2，4，8，…と倍々に増える。32768個体のうち，ある薬剤に耐性のある個体が何個体いるのかを調べた。この実験を100回行った結果，100回中3回の実験において，この薬剤に耐性のある個体が検出された。個体数は，それぞれ1，2，12であった。

突然変異率は低く，復帰突然変異（耐性をもった個体が耐性のない個体に変化する突然変異）は生じないと仮定し，さらに致死突然変異や分裂が非同期的になる突然変異は生じないと仮定したとき，細胞分裂あたりの突然変異率（総突然変異数を総細胞分裂数で割ったもの）を推定する式をA～Lから選べ。（5点）

A．3÷(32768×100)

B．3÷(32767×100)

C．3÷(15×100)

D．4÷(32768×100)

E．4÷(32767×100)

F．4÷(15×100)

G．5÷(32768×100)

H．5÷(32767×100)

I．5÷(15×100)

J．15÷(32768×100)

K．15÷(32767×100)

L．15÷(15×100)

problems.problem:
Escherichia coli (大腸菌) has the metabolic pathway shown in the figure, and substance C is essential for the growth of E. coli. E. coli has mutant strains ΔY and ΔXY: in mutant ΔY the activity of reaction Y has been lost, and in mutant ΔXY the activities of both reaction X and reaction Y have been lost.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/jbo-2021-1-4-fig1.png

Figure labels (Japanese → English): 野生型 = wild type; 変異株ΔY = mutant ΔY; 変異株ΔXY = mutant ΔXY; 物質A, 物質B, 物質C = substance A, substance B, substance C; 反応X = reaction X; 反応Y = reaction Y.

On the other hand, Arabidopsis thaliana (シロイヌナズナ) also has a similar metabolic pathway, and from the genome information of A. thaliana, Gene1 and Gene2 were identified as candidate genes for the enzyme that carries out reaction X, and Gene3 and Gene4 as candidate genes for the enzyme that carries out reaction Y.

These E. coli mutant strains were transformed with plasmids into which the A. thaliana genes Gene1, Gene2, Gene3 and Gene4, with their introns removed, had been inserted in the combinations shown in the table below, and whether the bacteria grew on a medium containing substance A but not substance B or substance C was checked, in order to find out which gene products have catalytic activity for reaction X or reaction Y. The + / − in the table are the results.

$$\begin{array}{l|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|c} \text{Combination of genes} & \text{Gene1} & \text{Gene2} & \text{Gene3} & \text{Gene4} & \text{Gene1 and Gene3} & \text{Gene1 and Gene4} & \text{Gene2 and Gene3} & \text{Gene2 and Gene4} \\ \hline \text{Mutant } \Delta\text{Y} & - & - & + & + & + & + & + & + \\ \text{Mutant } \Delta\text{XY} & - & - & - & - & + & + & - & - \end{array}$$

+: growth was observed. −: no growth was observed.

Which genes of A. thaliana carry out reaction X and reaction Y, respectively? Choose the appropriate combination from A–I. (6 points)

$$\begin{array}{c|c|c} & \text{Gene(s) involved in reaction X} & \text{Gene(s) involved in reaction Y} \\ \hline \text{A} & \text{Gene1} & \text{Gene3} \\ \text{B} & \text{Gene1} & \text{Gene4} \\ \text{C} & \text{Gene1} & \text{Gene3 and Gene4} \\ \text{D} & \text{Gene2} & \text{Gene3} \\ \text{E} & \text{Gene2} & \text{Gene4} \\ \text{F} & \text{Gene2} & \text{Gene3 and Gene4} \\ \text{G} & \text{Gene1 and Gene2} & \text{Gene3} \\ \text{H} & \text{Gene1 and Gene2} & \text{Gene4} \\ \text{I} & \text{Gene1 and Gene2} & \text{Gene3 and Gene4} \end{array}$$

大腸菌は図のような代謝経路をもち，物質Cは大腸菌の増殖に必須である。大腸菌には変異株ΔYと変異株ΔXYが存在し，変異株ΔYは反応Yの活性が，変異株△XYは反応Xと反応Yの両方の活性が失われている。

これらの大腸菌変異株に，イントロンを除いたシロイヌナズナのGene1，Gene2，Gene3，Gene4を下表のとおりの組合せでプラスミドに組み込んで形質転換し，物質Bと物質Cを含まず物質Aを含む培地での菌の増殖の有無を確認することで，どの遺伝子の産物が反応Xまたは反応Yの触媒活性をもっているのか調べた。表中の＋/－はその結果である。

$$\begin{array}{l|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|c} \text{遺伝子の組合せ} & \text{Gene1} & \text{Gene2} & \text{Gene3} & \text{Gene4} & \text{Gene1とGene3} & \text{Gene1とGene4} & \text{Gene2とGene3} & \text{Gene2とGene4} \\ \hline \text{変異株ΔY} & \text{－} & \text{－} & \text{＋} & \text{＋} & \text{＋} & \text{＋} & \text{＋} & \text{＋} \\ \text{変異株ΔXY} & \text{－} & \text{－} & \text{－} & \text{－} & \text{＋} & \text{＋} & \text{－} & \text{－} \end{array}$$

problems.problem:
If flowers can be kept for a long time without wilting, the commercial value of cut flowers increases. A great deal of energy is required for a flower to open. Carbohydrates accumulate in open flowers, but in cut flowers the amount of carbohydrate is known to decrease markedly after opening. A shortage of carbohydrate induces accelerated senescence. Ethylene is also involved in the senescence of many cut flowers. Techniques for making cut flowers last longer are currently being developed, and control of the amount of ethylene by adding carbohydrate is one of them.

To find out the relationship between carbohydrate and ethylene, the amount of ethylene produced by cut flowers of sweet pea (スイートピー) was examined. The figure shows the results. The sucrose-treated group (broken line) shows the day-to-day change in the amount of ethylene produced when open sweet peas were harvested as cut flowers and immersed for 8 days in an aqueous sucrose solution with a concentration of 100 g/L. The control group (solid line) is the result of immersion in distilled water for 4 days instead of the aqueous sucrose solution.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/jbo-2021-1-5-fig1.png

Figure labels (Japanese → English): エチレン生成量（nL/g生重量/時）= amount of ethylene produced (nL/g fresh weight/h); 収穫後時間（日）= time after harvest (days); 対照区 = control group; ショ糖処理区 = sucrose-treated group.

Which of the following statements are correct as interpretations, drawn from the results of this experiment, of the relationship between sucrose and ethylene? Choose from A–J the combination of correct statements. (5 points)

① Even when sucrose is added, ethylene is produced.

② When sucrose is added, ethylene production occurs earlier.

③ When the decrease in carbohydrate in cut flowers is suppressed, ethylene production is promoted.

④ Sweet pea is a plant that responds poorly to ethylene.

⑤ When sucrose is added, ethylene-mediated senescence is delayed.

A. ①②

B. ①③

C. ①④

D. ①⑤

E. ②③

F. ②④

G. ②⑤

H. ③④

I. ③⑤

J. ④⑤
problems.problem_orig:
花をしおれない状態で長期間維持できれば，切り花の商品価値は向上する。花が開くためには多くのエネルギーが必要である。開花した花には糖質が蓄積されるが，切り花においては，開花後糖質の量が著しく減少することが知られている。糖質の不足は老化の促進を誘導することになる。また，多くの切り花の老化にはエチレンが関係している。現在，切り花を長くもたせる技術が開発されているが，糖質の添加によるエチレン量の制御はその１つである。

糖質とエチレンの関係を知るため，スイートピーの切り花が生成するエチレン量を調べた。図はその結果である。ショ糖処理区（破線）は，開花したスイートピーを切り花として収穫し，それを100 g/Lの濃度のショ糖水溶液に8日間浸したときに生成するエチレン量の日変化を示している。対照区（実線）は，ショ糖水溶液の代わりに，蒸留水に4日間浸した結果である。

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/jbo-2021-1-5-fig1.png

次の記述のうち，この実験結果から考えられる，ショ糖とエチレンとの関係についての考察として正しいものはどれか。正しい記述の組合せをA～Jから選べ。（5点）

① ショ糖を添加しても，エチレンは生成される。

② ショ糖を添加すると，エチレンの生成が早まる。

③ 切り花の糖質の減少が抑えられると，エチレンの生成が促進される。

④ スイートピーはエチレンに反応しにくい植物である。

⑤ ショ糖を添加すると，エチレンを介した老化が遅延する。

A．①②

B．①③

C．①④

D．①⑤

E．②③

F．②④

G．②⑤

H．③④

I．③⑤

J．④⑤

problems.problem:
From studies of mutants and other work on the floral organs of Arabidopsis thaliana (シロイヌナズナ), the ABC model, which explains the mechanism by which floral organs are determined, has been proposed. In this ABC model, as shown in the figure, the floral meristem is divided, from the outside, into four regions: region 1 (sepals), region 2 (petals), region 3 (stamens) and region 4 (pistil). The floral organ of each region is then determined by the combination of genes acting in that region.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/jbo-2021-1-6-fig1.png

The four regions of the floral meristem

Figure labels (Japanese → English): がく片 = sepal; 花弁 = petal; おしべ = stamen; めしべ = pistil.

The ABC model consists mainly of three rules.

Rule 1: A-class genes determine the development of sepals; A-class genes and B-class genes, of petals; B-class genes and C-class genes, of stamens; and C-class genes, of the pistil.

Rule 2: A-class genes and C-class genes repress each other's expression.

Rule 3: In addition to their role in determining the development of floral organs, C-class genes also suppress the function of the stem cells present in the floral meristem and promote the switch from indeterminate to determinate growth. Consequently, once the floral organs have been formed, the growth of floral organs stops there.

Suppose there is a plant that forms its floral organs according to these rules. In this plant, what phenotypes are expected for the floral organs formed in region 1 and region 4 of a mutant in which the activity of the C-class genes is suppressed? And what phenotype is expected for the floral organ formed in region 1 of a mutant in which the C-class genes are artificially expressed in all regions? Choose from A–L the combination of expected floral organs. (6 points)

① Sepals arise in region 1.

② Petals arise in region 1.

③ Leaves arise in region 1.

④ A pistil arises in region 1.

⑤ Development of pistils occurs repeatedly in region 4.

⑥ Development of secondary flowers (floral organs consisting of sepals and petals) occurs repeatedly in region 4.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/jbo-2021-1-6-fig1.png

ABCモデルはおもに３つのルールから成り立っている。

ルール1：Aクラス遺伝子はがく片の，Aクラス遺伝子とBクラス遺伝子は花弁の，Bクラス遺伝子とCクラス遺伝子はおしべの，Cクラス遺伝子はめしべの発生を決定する。

ルール2：Aクラス遺伝子とCクラス遺伝子は互いの発現を抑制する。

ルール3：Cクラス遺伝子は，花器官の発生を決定するはたらきに加えて，花分裂組織に存在する幹細胞の機能を抑制し，無限成長から有限成長への切り替えを促すはたらきももつ。したがって，花器官はでき上がるとそこで花器官の成長は止まる。

このルールにもとづき，花器官を作る植物があるとする。この植物においてCクラス遺伝子の活性が抑えられた変異体の領域1と領域4で形成される花器官は，どのような表現型を示すと予想されるか。またCクラス遺伝子をすべての領域で人為的に発現させた変異体の領域1で形成される花器官は，どのような表現型を示すと予想されるか。予想される花器官の組合せをA～Lから選べ。（6点）

① 領域1にがく片が生じる。

② 領域1に花弁が生じる。

④ 領域1にめしべが生じる。

⑥ 領域4に2次花（がく片と花弁からなる花器官）の発生が繰り返し生じる。

Eighty-five individuals were selected from a certain habitat, and for each individual the number of flowers was counted in May and the number of fruits in September. These individuals were classified into five groups according to their number of flowers, and the mean number of fruits per individual and the mean fruit set were determined. ある植物は，多数の花を咲かせる自家不和合性の多年草であり，花の数にくらべて果実の数が少ないという特徴をもっている。また，受粉は昆虫を介して行われる。ある生育地から85個体を選び，それぞれの個体について，5月に花の数を，9月に果実の数を調べた。これらの個体を花の数により５つのグループに分類し，個体あたりの平均果実数と平均結実率を求めた。なお，結実率は果実の数を花の数で割ったものであり，平均結実率はそれぞれの個体の結実率の平均値である。下表はその結果である。

$$\begin{array}{l|c|c|c|c|c} \text{花の数} & \text{99以下} & \text{100～199} & \text{200～499} & \text{500～999} & \text{1000以上} \\ \hline \text{平均果実数} & 2.13 & 3.50 & 3.78 & 6.25 & 3.25 \\ \text{平均結実率} & \text{3.0％} & \text{2.5％} & \text{1.3％} & \text{1.0％} & \text{0.3％} \end{array}$$

虫媒花の自家不和合性植物では，上記の両面を考える必要がある。表の結果だけで判断すると，もっとも適応度が高いと考えられるのは，花の数が（ ウ ）のグループである。

② 不利

Many migratory birds head for their destination while resting at stopover sites. Stopover sites are important not only as places to rest but also for replenishing water and food. When there is sea on the flight route, this section must be flown non-stop. What happens when there is desert on the flight route? To find this out, the following observations were made.

problems.problem:
(7 points)

Some biomolecules and drugs involved in life phenomena exist as enantiomers (also called mirror-image isomers, antipodes or optical isomers). Enantiomers are isomers that are mirror images of each other (a counterpart reflected in a mirror, or the relationship between the right and left hands), and are written as the D form and L form or the R form and S form. Whether the three-dimensional structure of a molecule gives rise to enantiomers depends on an "asymmetric carbon", to which four different atoms or groups of atoms are bonded. When biomolecules or drugs are synthesised chemically, they are often produced as a racemate (a mixture of enantiomers), but in living organisms sometimes only a particular enantiomer is produced. Also, when the physiological activities of enantiomers are compared, a particular enantiomer sometimes shows a higher activity.

Question 1

(あ)–(う) of Figure 1-1 show the structural formulae of various biomolecules. The carbons appearing in these structural formulae are numbered (the number above, or to the upper left of, the carbon). On this basis, choose all the numbers of the "asymmetric carbons" contained in the biomolecules (あ)–(う), and mark all the corresponding numbers in the answer box. If there is no "asymmetric carbon", mark (0); if all are "asymmetric carbons", mark (9).

(あ) Glucose. Answer box: 1

(い) Glycine. Answer box: 2

(う) Isoleucine. Answer box: 3

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/jbo-2021-2-1-fig1.png

Figure labels (Japanese → English): (あ) グルコース = (あ) glucose; (い) グリシン = (い) glycine; (う) イソロイシン = (う) isoleucine.

Figure 1-1. Structural formulae of various biomolecules

Question 2

Concerning enantiomers, judge whether each of the following statements (1)–(4) is true or false, and mark the numbers of all the options judged to be correct in the answer box. If you judge that all the statements are correct, mark only (9); if you judge that there is no correct statement, mark only (0). Answer box: 4

(1) A particular enantiomer cannot be separated from a racemate.

(2) Most of the monosaccharides that have natural enantiomers are of the D form.

(3) The amino acids that make up proteins and have enantiomers are all of the D form.

(4) The reason why the physiological activity differs between enantiomers is that, when the compounds bind to the target protein, each binds in a stereochemically different arrangement.

Question 3

Thalidomide was used in the 1950s as an anti-nausea drug and a sleeping drug for pregnant women, but its use was banned because it has severe teratogenicity for the foetus (it induces malformations of the limbs). Later it became clear that thalidomide is effective against intractable diseases such as Hansen's disease (leprosy) and multiple myeloma, and its use is now approved provided that strict regulations on its administration are observed.

Thalidomide exists as R and S enantiomers, and in 1979 it was reported that only the S form is teratogenic. On the other hand, it is known that R- or S-thalidomide administered into the body rapidly undergoes a change in its three-dimensional structure and becomes a racemate, so there was a contradiction as to why the result that only the S form is teratogenic had been obtained (the thalidomide paradox). Recent research has shown that, when the R and S forms of thalidomide are mixed, the two bind to each other to form a stable dimer, and the dimer has a lower solubility and is less easily absorbed into cells from the digestive tract or the blood. In another study, the protein to which thalidomide binds in the cell (cereblon) was identified, and it also became clear that teratogenicity arises because the function of cereblon changes when thalidomide is bound to it. Furthermore, analysis of the three-dimensional structure of the cereblon protein revealed the details of the binding sites and binding modes of R- and S-thalidomide.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/jbo-2021-2-1-fig2.png

Figure labels (Japanese → English): R型 = R form; S型 = S form.

Figure 1-2. Structural formulae of thalidomide

On the basis of these research results, judge whether each of the following statements (1)–(5) explaining the thalidomide paradox (why was the result obtained that only the S form is teratogenic?) is true or false, and mark the numbers of all the options judged to be correct in the answer box. If you judge that all the statements are correct, mark only (9); if you judge that there is no correct statement, mark only (0). Answer box: 5

(1) In the body, S-thalidomide is chemically more stable than the R form.

(2) S-thalidomide binds more strongly to cereblon than the R form.

(3) R-thalidomide administered into the body all changes its three-dimensional structure into the S form.

(4) When a large amount of R-thalidomide is administered, the S form produced by the change in three-dimensional structure rapidly binds to the R form and becomes less easily absorbed.

(5) When a large amount of S-thalidomide is administered, a change occurs in the gene sequence of cereblon.
problems.problem_orig:
(7点)

生命現象に関わる生体分子や薬物には鏡像異性体（エナンチオマー、対掌体、光学異性体ともいう）が存在するものがある。鏡像異性体とは互いに鏡像体（鏡に映った相手、あるいは右手と左手の関係）となる異性体で、D型・L型あるいはR型・S型と表記する。ある分子の立体構造が鏡像異性体となるかどうかは、異なる4種の原子もしくは原子団が結合した「不斉炭素」に起因する。生体分子や薬物を化学的に合成した場合、ラセミ体（鏡像異性体の混合物）として生成することが多いが、生体内では特定の鏡像異性体のみが生成している場合がある。また、鏡像異性体間での生理活性を比較した場合、特定の鏡像異性体の方が高い活性を示す場合がある。

問1

図1-1の(あ)-(う)に、様々な生体分子の構造式を示した。また、これら構造式の中に出現する炭素に番号をふってある(炭素の上、もしくは左上の数字)。これをもとに、(あ)-(う)の生体分子に含まれる「不斉炭素」の番号を全て選び、該当する番号を解答欄に全てマークしなさい。なお、「不斉炭素」がない場合は(0)をマークし、全てが「不斉炭素」の場合は(9)をマークしなさい。

(あ) グルコース　解答欄は 1

(い) グリシン　解答欄は 2

(う) イソロイシン　解答欄は 3

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/jbo-2021-2-1-fig1.png

図1-1. さまざまな生体分子の構造式

問2

鏡像異性体に関して、以下の(1)-(4)の記述の正誤を判定し、正しいと判断される選択肢の番号を解答欄に全てマークしなさい。なお、全ての記述が正しいと判断した場合は(9)だけをマークし、正しい記述が無いと判断した場合は(0)だけをマークしなさい。解答欄は 4

(1) ラセミ体から特定の鏡像異性体を分離することはできない。

(2) 天然の鏡像異性体を有する単糖類の大部分は、D型である。

(3) タンパク質を構成する鏡像異性体を有するアミノ酸は、全てD型である。

(4) 鏡像異性体間で生理活性が異なる理由は、化合物が標的タンパク質に結合する際に、それぞれが立体構造的に異なる配置で結合することに由来する。

問3

サリドマイドは1950年代に妊婦に対して吐き気防止薬や睡眠導入薬として使用されたが、胎児に対して深刻な形成異常誘発性（四肢の形成異常を誘導）を有することから使用が禁止された。その後、サリドマイドがハンセン病や多発性骨髄腫などの難病に有効であることが明らかとなり、現在は厳格な投薬規制を遵守した上での使用が認可されている。

サリドマイドにはR型・S型の鏡像異性体が存在し、1979年にS型のみ形成異常誘発性を有するという報告がされた。一方、生体内に投与したR型あるいはS型サリドマイドは速やかに立体構造変化を起こし、ラセミ体となることが知られており、なぜS型のみ形成異常誘発性を有するという結果が得られたのか矛盾があった（サリドマイドパラドックス）。最近の研究によると、サリドマイドはR型とS型が混在すると両者は結合して安定な二量体を形成し、二量体は溶解度が低下し、消化管あるいは血中から細胞内に吸収されにくくなるという結果が示された。また、別の研究では細胞内でサリドマイドが結合するタンパク質（セレブロン）が同定され、サリドマイドが結合したセレブロンはその機能が変化することにより形成異常誘発性が生じることも明らかとなった。さらにセレブロンタンパク質の立体構造解析の結果、R型・S型サリドマイドとの結合部位と結合様式の詳細も明らかとなった。

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/jbo-2021-2-1-fig2.png

図1-2. サリドマイドの構造式

これらの研究成果をもとに、サリドマイドパラドックス（なぜS型のみ形成異常誘発性を有するという結果が得られたのか？）を説明する下記の(1)-(5)の記述の正誤を判定し、正しいと判断される選択肢の番号を全て解答欄にマークしなさい。なお、全ての記述が正しいと判断した場合は(9)だけをマークし、正しい記述が無いと判断した場合は(0)だけをマークしなさい。解答欄は 5

(1) 生体内ではS型サリドマイドの方がR型より化学的に安定である。

(2) S型サリドマイドの方がR型よりセレブロンに強く結合する。

(3) 生体内で投与されたR型サリドマイドは、全てS型に立体構造変化する。

(4) R型サリドマイドを大量に投与した場合、立体構造変化により生じたS型は速やかにR型と結合し、吸収されにくくなる。

(5) S型サリドマイドを大量に投与した場合、セレブロンの遺伝子配列に変化が生じる。

Bacillus subtilis (枯草菌) is a model organism whose genome sequence is completely known, and its genome size is about 4.2 million base pairs. It was found that a DNA sequence had newly been inserted into the genome of this B. subtilis (hereafter this inserted sequence is written IS). The length of the IS is 1,012 base pairs, and the sequences of 15 bases at its two ends and the positions at which it is cut by restriction enzymes are known (Figure 3-1). However, it is not known at which position in the B. subtilis genome the IS is inserted.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/jbo-2021-2-3-fig1.png

Figure 3-1. Schematic diagram of the DNA sequence inserted into the genome of B. subtilis

To determine the insertion position of the IS, it was decided to carry out an experiment by the following procedure. In this experiment, a PCR machine is used at some stage.

(あ) Purify genomic DNA of high purity from the B. subtilis into which this sequence has been inserted.

(い) Design PCR primers of 15 bases each on the basis of regions (A) and (B) in Figure 3-1.

(う) Carry out an experiment using the DNA purified in (あ), the PCR primers designed in (い), and those of the enzymes in the laboratory that are needed. The enzymes in the laboratory are as in Table 3-1. All these enzymes have sufficient activity in this problem.

(え) Finally obtain a PCR-amplified fragment by the above experiment, and read the DNA sequence of the fragment by dideoxyribonucleotide chain-termination sequencing.

Table 3-1. Enzymes in the laboratory

In PCR, the time of the extension reaction is adjusted according to the length of the target DNA sequence, at a rate of 60 seconds per 1,000 base pairs. (4 points)

Most land plants are sessile organisms that cannot move from the place where they germinated, and they survive by sensitively perceiving their surrounding environment, which changes from moment to moment. When these senses are compared with those of mammals, some are similar and some are very different. Choose from the following (1)–(5) all the statements that have been proved, in plant physiology experiments so far, as abilities of plants to perceive the environment, and mark all the numbers of the chosen options in the answer box. If you judge that all the statements are correct, mark only (9); if you judge that there is no correct statement, mark only (0). Answer box: 21

(1) A sense corresponding to sight exists, and plants can distinguish colours.

(2) A sense corresponding to hearing exists, and plants can perceive the sounds made by herbivores.

(3) A sense corresponding to taste exists, and plants can distinguish places with nutrients from places without.

(4) A sense corresponding to smell exists, and plants can sense odours emitted by neighbouring plants.

(5) A sense corresponding to touch exists, and plants can perceive being stroked by a person.

problems.problem:
(6 points)

In the electron transport reactions of photosynthesis, electrons extracted from water are excited by light in the photosystem II complex (PSII) and passed to the cytochrome $b_6f$ complex (Cyt$b_6f$); they are then excited again by light in the photosystem I complex (PSI) and used for the synthesis of NADPH, which supplies reducing power. These protein complexes are not distributed uniformly in the thylakoid membrane, but have an uneven distribution (Figure 7-1). Carriers that transport electrons between the complexes are therefore needed: between PSII and Cyt$b_6f$ this role is taken by plastoquinone, a kind of quinone, and between Cyt$b_6f$ and PSI by plastocyanin, an acidic protein.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/jbo-2021-2-7-fig1.png

Figure labels (Japanese → English): 拡大図 = enlarged view; 光化学系I複合体 = photosystem I complex; シトクロム$b_6f$複合体 = cytochrome $b_6f$ complex; 光化学系II複合体 = photosystem II complex; ストロマラメラ = stroma lamellae; グラナラメラ = grana lamellae.

Figure 7-1. Schematic diagram of a chloroplast

Question 1

Read the distribution of each protein complex from the figure, and choose the most appropriate combination as its description from the following (1)–(8); mark the number of the option in the answer box. Answer box: 23

Question 2

Because the activities of PSI and PSII change with the light conditions, plants need to adjust the ratio of their activities flexibly. One of the mechanisms for this is the state transition. In this mechanism, the phosphorylation state of the light-harvesting antenna protein (LHC) changes according to the oxidation–reduction state of plastoquinone, and this changes whether the LHC attaches to PSI or to PSII. As a description of the state transition, choose the one or two most appropriate options from the following (1)–(8), and mark the numbers of the options in the answer box. Answer box: 24

(1) When the activity of PSI decreases and oxidised plastoquinone accumulates, LHC binds to PSI.

(2) When the activity of PSI decreases and oxidised plastoquinone accumulates, LHC binds to PSII.

(3) When the activity of PSI decreases and reduced plastoquinone accumulates, LHC binds to PSI.

(4) When the activity of PSI decreases and reduced plastoquinone accumulates, LHC binds to PSII.

(5) When the activity of PSII decreases and oxidised plastoquinone accumulates, LHC binds to PSI.

(6) When the activity of PSII decreases and oxidised plastoquinone accumulates, LHC binds to PSII.

(7) When the activity of PSII decreases and reduced plastoquinone accumulates, LHC binds to PSI.

(8) When the activity of PSII decreases and reduced plastoquinone accumulates, LHC binds to PSII.

問2

植物は、光条件によってPSIやPSIIの活性が変化するため、臨機応変にそれぞれの活性の比を調整する必要がある。そのしくみの一つにステート遷移がある。このしくみでは、プラストキノンの酸化・還元状態によって、光を捕集するアンテナタンパク質(LHC)のリン酸化状態が変化し、それによってLHCがPSIに付くのか、PSIIに付くのかを変化させる。ステート遷移の記述として、最も適当なものを以下の(1)-(8)から1つもしくは2つ選び、選択肢の番号を解答欄にマークしなさい。解答欄は 24

(6) PSIIの活性が低下し酸化型のプラストキノンが蓄積すると、LHCはPSIIに結合する。

(7) PSIIの活性が低下し還元型のプラストキノンが蓄積すると、LHCはPSIに結合する。

(8) PSIIの活性が低下し還元型のプラストキノンが蓄積すると、LHCはPSIIに結合する。

(6 points)

Mesenchymal stem cells are multipotent and can differentiate into various cells such as bone and cartilage. Mesenchymal stem cells differentiate into different cells depending on the reagents added to the medium, but in recent years it has been shown that the direction of differentiation also changes with the stiffness of the substrate (something like a foundation) on which the cells are cultured. Here, mesenchymal stem cells were differentiated on two kinds of substrate of different stiffness. The culture conditions of the two are assumed to be all the same except for the stiffness of the substrate (Figure 8-1).

Figure labels (Japanese → English): 細胞 = cell; 基板(柔または硬) = substrate (soft or stiff).

Figure 8-1. Outline of the culture

(あ) Protein X has the role of responding to extracellular stimuli and transmitting the signal into the nucleus. When the extracellular stimulus is OFF, protein X is present in the cytoplasm, but when a stimulus is applied, protein X moves into the nucleus and activates the expression of target genes. The locations of protein X in the cells cultured on the two kinds of substrate were as shown in Figure 8-2A.

(い) Differentiated osteoblasts react with an alkaline phosphatase (ALP) detection reagent and develop a blue colour. On the other hand, differentiated adipocytes are stained red by a dye called Oil Red O (ORO). When normal mesenchymal stem cells (normal cells) and mesenchymal stem cells in which the gene encoding protein X had been deleted (deleted cells) were differentiated on stiff and soft substrates and stained with ALP and ORO respectively, the results shown in Figure 8-2B were obtained.

Figure labels (Japanese → English): 核 = nucleus; 細胞膜 = cell membrane; 柔 = soft; 硬 = stiff; 基板の硬さ = stiffness of the substrate; ALP染色の濃さ(相対値) = intensity of ALP staining (relative value); ORO染色の濃さ(相対値) = intensity of ORO staining (relative value); 基板 = substrate; 細胞 = cells; 正常 = normal; 欠損 = deleted.

As hypotheses derived from the above data, judge whether each of the following statements (1)–(4) is correct, and mark the numbers of all the options judged to be correct. If you judge that all the statements are correct, mark only (9); if you judge that there is no correct statement, mark only (0). Answer box: 25

(1) When protein X is present in the nucleus, normal cells are thought to differentiate readily into adipocytes.

(2) Protein X present in the cytoplasm and protein X present in the nucleus are thought to regulate different genes.

(3) Normal cells cultured on a stiff substrate are thought to differentiate into adipocytes more readily than when cultured on a soft substrate.

problems.problem_orig:
(6点)

間葉系幹細胞は多分化能をもっており、骨や軟骨などさまざまな細胞に分化できる。間葉系幹細胞は、培地に加える試薬の違いによって異なる細胞に分化するが、近年、細胞を培養する際の基板（土台のようなもの）の硬さによっても分化の方向が変わることが示された。ここで、間葉系幹細胞を硬さの違う二種類の基板上で分化させた。両者の培養条件は基板の硬さ以外すべて同じであるとする(図8-1)。

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/jbo-2021-2-8-fig1.png

図8-1. 培養の概略

(あ) タンパク質Xは細胞外の刺激に応答してその信号を核内に伝える役割がある。細胞外の刺激がOFFのときタンパク質Xは細胞質に存在するが、刺激が加わるとタンパク質Xは核に移動し、標的遺伝子の発現を活性化する。二種類の基板で培養した細胞におけるタンパク質Xの存在場所はそれぞれ図8-2Aのとおりであった。

(い) 分化した骨芽細胞はアルカリフォスファターゼ(ALP)検出試薬に反応し青く発色する。一方、分化した脂肪細胞はオイルレッド(ORO)という色素で赤く染色される。正常な間葉系幹細胞（正常細胞）、タンパク質Xをコードする遺伝子を欠損した間葉系幹細胞（欠損細胞）を用い、硬い基板、柔らかい基板で分化させ、ALP、OROでそれぞれ染色すると図8-2Bのような結果が得られた。

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/jbo-2021-2-8-fig2.png

図8-2. (A) それぞれの基板で培養した細胞におけるタンパク質Xの存在場所(グレーの塗り潰しで示す). (B)ALP、ORO染色の結果.

以上のデータから導き出される仮説として、以下の(1)-(4)の記述が正しいかどうかを判定し、正しいと判断される選択肢の番号を全てマークしなさい。なお、全ての記述が正しいと判断した場合は(9)だけをマークし、正しい記述がないと判断した場合は(0)だけをマークしなさい。解答欄は 25

(1) タンパク質Xが核に存在している時、正常細胞は脂肪細胞に分化しやすいと考えられる。

(2) 細胞質に存在するタンパク質Xと核に存在するタンパク質Xは異なる遺伝子を制御すると考えられる。

(3) 硬い基板で培養された正常細胞は柔らかい基板で培養するより脂肪細胞に分化しやすいと考えられる。

(4) 欠損細胞を硬い基板で培養すると、細胞は正常細胞に比べ、脂肪細胞に分化しやすいと考えられる。

(5) 欠損細胞を柔らかい基板で培養すると、細胞は正常細胞と同様、骨芽細胞に分化しやすいと考えられる。

Consider an experiment attempting to knock out gene A by the CRISPR/Cas9 method. As shown in Figure 9-1A, a guide RNA targeting gene A and Cas9 protein were microinjected into fertilised eggs (1-cell stage) of the tropical clawed frog (ネッタイツメガエル) before the first cleavage, and the embryos were reared for 14 days until they became tadpoles. Then part of the tail of a tadpole was taken, genomic DNA was extracted, and a region of the genomic DNA was amplified by PCR so as to include the sequence to which the guide RNA binds. The sequence to which the guide RNA binds is the underlined part of the base sequence shown in Figure 9-1B, and the boxed part indicates the start codon. The sequence shown in this figure contains no intron. The guide RNA and Cas9 protein injected into the fertilised egg cut the DNA sequence at the underlined part of Figure 9-1B or its vicinity in the developing embryo. DNA repair enzymes in the embryo repair the cut region, but in doing so the DNA sequence is sometimes mutated, with bases near the cut region being lost or extra nucleotides being inserted. This cutting and repair continues independently in each cell until, as a result of the mutation of the base sequence, the guide RNA can no longer recognise the target sequence, or until the guide RNA and Cas9 are completely degraded in the cell. Consequently, the PCR fragments amplified in this experiment have diverse base sequences in the vicinity of the underlined part of Figure 9-1B. Now, following the procedure of Figure 9-1A, the base sequences of 9,000 molecules of PCR product were determined by next-generation sequencing analysis, and the patterns of base sequences of the PCR products were as in Table 9-1. Of the statements (1)–(5) given below, choose all those thought to be correct. The tropical clawed frog is diploid, and Cas9 and the guide RNA diffuse rapidly throughout the egg after injection and are completely degraded within 1 day of injection, after which no new mutations of the base sequence arise. In this experiment, cutting by CRISPR/Cas9 is assumed not to occur anywhere other than the underlined part of Figure 9-1B. Answer box: 26

problems.problem:
(5 points)

The blood circulation of mammals is a double circulation, consisting of the pulmonary circulation, which runs from the right ventricle through the lungs and into the left atrium, and the systemic circulation, which runs from the left ventricle through the whole body and into the right atrium. In both, blood sent out from the heart branches from the aorta into arterioles, reaches the capillary bed of one organ, merges again to form veins and returns to the heart (Figure 10-1A). In the circulatory system of mammals this principle is broken in several places. There, the blood vessels that have formed a capillary bed in one organ merge again into a vessel with a vein-like structure, and then, without returning directly to the heart, form a capillary bed again and supply another organ (Figure 10-1B). A vein-like vessel linking two organs is called a portal vein. One of the portal veins that mammals have is found in the liver (Figure 10-2). In humans, the total blood volume is about 5 L, of which about 4.5 L is in the systemic circulation and about 0.5 L in the pulmonary circulation.

Figure 10-1. Blood circulation of mammals

Figure 10-2. Blood circulation and the hepatic portal vein

Question 1

Where else in the mammalian body is a portal vein found? Choose only one from the following (1)–(5), and mark the number of the option in the answer box. Answer box: 27

(1) Thymus

(2) Bone marrow

(3) Heart (coronary arteries)

(4) Lungs

(5) Brain

Question 2

If the portal vein found in the organ given as the answer to Question 1 is a trait that was selected and acquired in evolution because it brings some benefit to the individual, what was the benefit that the acquisition of this portal vein brought to the individual? Choose the one most appropriate statement from the following (1)–(4), and mark the number of the option in the answer box. Answer box: 28

(1) The organ immediately downstream of the portal vein can capture and detoxify harmful substances secreted into the blood by the organ upstream of the portal vein before they circulate through the whole body.

(2) The organ immediately downstream of the portal vein can receive hormones secreted by the organ upstream of the portal vein immediately and at high concentration.

(3) The organ immediately downstream of the portal vein can sense the components of the blood flowing in from the portal vein and make up for metabolism that was insufficient in the organ upstream of the portal vein.

(4) Cells that have started to migrate from the organ immediately before the portal vein can, first of all, reach the organ immediately after the portal vein without fail.

Question 3

Besides ordinary oxygen-rich arterial blood, which reaches the liver directly from the hepatic artery, a branch of the aorta, blood flows into the liver from a portal vein called the hepatic portal vein (Figure 10-2). The blood flowing in from the hepatic portal vein has supplied the abdominal digestive organs (other than the liver), such as the stomach, small intestine, large intestine, pancreas and spleen, as capillary beds, and has then merged. The blood of the capillary beds of these abdominal digestive organs all merges into the hepatic portal vein; there is no circulatory route returning directly to the heart. In humans, the blood volume of the liver is about 0.45 L, and the blood flow, hepatic artery and portal vein together, is about 1.35 L/min.

Of insulin and glucagon, which play the main roles in maintaining glucose homeostasis, insulin is secreted from the β cells contained in the cell clusters in the pancreas called the islets of Langerhans. The secreted insulin flows via the veins of the pancreas through the hepatic portal vein into the liver.

The β cells sense the glucose concentration (blood glucose level) in the blood in the surrounding capillaries, secrete insulin according to the situation, and contribute to the maintenance of glucose homeostasis throughout the body. The secreted insulin stimulates the liver, muscle, adipose tissue and so on, and brings about a decrease in the glucose concentration in the blood, for example by promoting the storage of carbohydrate as glycogen. Most of the secreted insulin is degraded in the liver; in humans it is almost completely degraded within about 70 minutes of secretion.

In which blood vessels is the blood thought to flow that shows the blood glucose level closest to the blood glucose level sensed by the β cells? Choose two appropriate options from the following (1)–(5), and mark the numbers of the options in two places in the answer box. Answer box: 29

(1) Hepatic artery

(2) Capillary bed of the liver

(3) Hepatic portal vein

(4) Renal vein

(5) Aorta

哺乳類の血液循環は、右心室から肺を巡って左心房に流れ込む肺循環と、左心室から全身を巡って右心房に流れ込む体循環の二重循環となっている。いずれも心臓から送りだされた血液は大動脈から動脈細枝に分岐してひとつの器官の毛細血管床に達し、再合流して静脈となって心臓に戻る（図10-1A）。哺乳類の循環系では数カ所でこの原則が破られている。そこでは、ある器官で毛細血管床となった血管が、静脈に似た構造の血管に再合流した後、直接心臓には戻らず、再び毛細血管床を形成して別の器官に分布する（図10-1B）。ふたつの器官を結ぶ静脈に似た血管を門脈と呼ぶ。哺乳類が有する門脈のひとつは肝臓に見られる（図10-2）。ヒトでは、全身の血液量が約5L、うち体循環が約4.5L、肺循環が約0.5Lである。

問1で解答した器官に見られる門脈が、個体にとって何らかの利得があるために進化的に選択され獲得された形質であるとするなら、この門脈の獲得が個体にもたらした利得は何だっただろうか。以下の(1)-(4)から最も適切な記述を1つ選び、選択肢の番号を解答欄にマークしなさい。解答欄は 28

(1) 門脈の直後にある器官は、門脈の上流の器官が血中に分泌した有害物質を、全身に循環する以前に捕捉して解毒することができる。

問3

肝臓には、大動脈の枝である肝動脈から直に肝臓に達する酸素に富んだ通常の動脈血の他に、肝門脈と呼ばれる門脈から血液が流入する(図10-2)。肝門脈から流入する血液は、胃、小腸、大腸、膵臓、脾臓といった（肝臓を除く）腹部の消化器官に毛細血管床となって分布し、その後合流したものである。これら腹部消化器官の毛細血管床の血液は、すべて肝門脈に合流し、直接心臓へと帰る循環経路はない。ヒトでは、肝臓の血液量は約0.45L、血流量は肝動脈、門脈合わせて約1.35L/分である。

グルコースホメオスタシスを維持する上で主要な役割を果たすインスリン、グルカゴンのうち、インスリンは膵臓内のランゲルハンス島と呼ばれる細胞塊に含まれるβ細胞から分泌される。分泌されたインスリンは、膵臓の静脈を経て肝門脈から肝臓へと流れ込む。

β細胞は、周囲の毛細血管内の血液中のグルコース濃度（血糖値）を感知して、状況に応じてインスリンを分泌し、全身のグルコースホメオスタシスの維持に寄与している。分泌されたインスリンは、肝臓、筋肉、脂肪組織などを刺激し、糖質のグリコーゲンとしての貯蔵を促進するなどして、血液中のグルコース濃度の低下をもたらす。分泌されたインスリンはそのほとんどが肝臓で分解され、ヒトでは、分泌後70分程度でほぼ完全に分解される。

β細胞が感知している血糖値に最も近い血糖値を呈する血液が流れていると考えられる血管はどれか。以下の(1)-(5)から適切なものを2つ選び、選択肢の番号を解答欄に2箇所マークしなさい。解答欄は 29

(1) 肝動脈

(2) 肝臓の毛細血管床

(3) 肝門脈

(4) 腎静脈

(5) 大動脈

problems.problem:
(4 points)

Diabetes, one of the representative lifestyle-related diseases, is a disease in which, for some reason, glucose homeostasis can no longer be maintained normally, and irreversible damage occurs in various organs of the whole body because a state of high blood glucose continues. One of its causes is a state in which, because of a decline in the function of the β cells, insulin is not secreted sufficiently even when the blood glucose level rises. For patients in this state there is a treatment in which insulin is injected subcutaneously after meals, when the blood glucose level is thought to be rising, to lower the blood glucose level. Subcutaneous injection is a technique in which the injection needle passes through the epithelial tissue and the drug is injected into the connective tissue beneath it. The drug injected into the connective tissue is gradually absorbed into the surrounding capillary beds, eventually merges into the vena cava, and after passing through the pulmonary circulation is sent out from the heart to the whole body. Because the transfer of the drug from the connective tissue to the capillary beds is gradual, a sharp rise in the blood concentration of the drug is less likely to occur than with, for example, intravenous injection, in which the drug is injected directly into a blood vessel.

Question 1

Here, assume that the insulin secreted by β cells and the insulin of the injected drug have the same molecular function. Assume that insulin is injected subcutaneously into a diabetic patient after a meal, and that the same amount as the insulin physiologically secreted from β cells flows from the subcutaneous tissue into the nearby capillaries over the same time course (the assumptions of this question differ from the pharmacokinetics etc. in actual treatment). In this case, which can be thought of as a difference between the body's response to the physiological insulin secreted by β cells and the body's response to the insulin injected subcutaneously this time? Choose the one statement thought to be most appropriate from the following (1)–(4), and mark the number of the option in the answer box. Answer box: 30

(1) Much of the subcutaneously injected insulin is used up in the muscle and fat around the injection site, and the amount reaching the liver and distant muscle and fat is limited.

(2) Because the subcutaneously injected insulin reaches the target tissues such as the liver and muscle after passing through the heart, lungs, aorta and so on, its effect is reduced compared with the amount injected.

(3) The subcutaneously injected insulin exerts on the muscles of the whole body an effect roughly equal to or greater than that of insulin derived from β cells, whereas its effect on the liver is reduced.

(4) The subcutaneously injected insulin exerts on the liver an effect roughly equal to or greater than that of insulin derived from β cells, whereas its effect on muscle is reduced.

Question 2

If there were no hepatic portal vein in the blood circulation of mammals, and the abdominal digestive organs, including the liver, were connected to the ordinary circulatory route, so that the blood collected after passing through the capillary beds flowed via veins directly into the right atrium, what would be thought to happen? Choose two appropriate options from the following (1)–(4), and mark the numbers of the options in two places in the answer box. Answer box: 31

(1) Because more oxygen-rich blood is supplied to the liver, the efficiency of liver function in general improves.

(2) Because the blood circulations of the liver and of the other digestive organs become independent, the blood flow to the abdominal digestive organs increases and the blood flow to other organs such as the brain decreases correspondingly.

(3) Because the nutrients absorbed in the digestive tract are supplied to the whole body almost unchanged, the daily fluctuations in the concentrations of nutrients in the blood, such as glucose, become larger.

(4) Because the harmful substances absorbed in the digestive tract are supplied to the whole body almost unchanged, the organs that receive harmful effects are exposed to greater danger.
problems.problem_orig:
(4点)

代表的な生活習慣病のひとつである糖尿病は、何らかの原因でグルコースホメオスタシスを正常に維持することができなくなり、高血糖の状態がつづくことによって全身の様々な器官に不可逆の障害が起こる疾患である。その原因のひとつに、β細胞の機能低下により、血糖値が上昇してもインスリンが十分に分泌されない状態がある。こうした状態の患者に、血糖値が上昇していると考えられる食後にインスリンを皮下注射して血糖値を下げる治療法がある。皮下注射は、注射針で上皮組織を貫通し、その内側にある結合組織に薬剤を注入する手技である。結合組織に注入された薬剤は、周囲の毛細血管床に徐々に吸収され、やがて大静脈に合流して、肺循環を経た後に心臓から全身に送りだされる。結合組織から毛細血管床への薬剤の移行が緩やかであるため、血管に直接薬剤を注入する静脈注射などと比較して、薬剤の血中濃度の急激な上昇が起こりにくい。

問1

ここで、β細胞が分泌するインスリンと、注射薬のインスリンの分子機能が同じであるとする。食後の糖尿病患者にインスリンを皮下注射し、β細胞から生理的に分泌されるインスリンと同じ量が、同じ時間経過とともに皮下組織から近傍の毛細血管中に流入したとする（本問の仮定は実際の治療での薬物動態等とは異なる）。このとき、β細胞が分泌する生理的インスリンに対する身体の反応と、今回皮下注射したインスリンに対する身体の反応との間に見られる差違として考えられるのはどれか。以下の(1)-(4)から最も適切と考えられる記述を1つ選び、選択肢の番号を解答欄にマークしなさい。解答欄は 30

(1) 皮下注射したインスリンは、注射した部位の周辺の筋肉、脂肪でその多くが消費されてしまい、肝臓や離れた筋肉、脂肪に到達する量は限られている。

(2) 皮下注射したインスリンは、心臓、肺、大動脈などを経てから肝臓や筋肉などの標的組織に達するため、注射した量に比べ効果が減少する。

(3) 皮下注射したインスリンは、全身の筋肉に対してはβ細胞由来のインスリンとおおむね同等あるいはそれ以上の効果を発揮する一方、肝臓への効果が減少する。

(4) 皮下注射したインスリンは、肝臓に対してはβ細胞由来のインスリンとおおむね同等あるいはそれ以上の効果を発揮する一方、筋肉への効果が減少する。

問2

もし、哺乳類の血液循環に肝門脈が存在せず、肝臓を含む腹部の消化器官が通常の循環経路に接続され、毛細血管床を経て集合した血液が静脈を経て直接右心房へと流れ込む構造になっていた場合にどんなことが起こると考えられるか。以下の(1)-(4)から適切なものを2つ選び、選択肢の番号を解答欄に2箇所マークしなさい。解答欄は 31

(1) より多くの酸素に富んだ血液が肝臓に供給されるため、肝機能全般の効率が向上する。

(2) 肝臓とその他の消化器官の血液循環が独立することにより、腹部の消化器官の血流量が増加し、その分、脳など他器官への血流量が減少する。

(3) 消化管で吸収された栄養素がほぼそのまま全身に供給されるため、グルコースをはじめとする血中の栄養素の濃度の日内変動が大きくなる。

(4) 消化管で吸収された有害物質がほぼそのまま全身に供給されるため、有害な影響を受ける器官がより大きな危険にさらされる。

problems.problem:
(5 points)

Information transmission from one nerve cell to another takes place at sites called synapses. The various neurotransmitters released from the presynaptic cell bind to receptors on the postsynaptic membrane and produce excitatory or inhibitory postsynaptic potentials in the postsynaptic cell. Normally, glutamate and acetylcholine act as excitatory neurotransmitters, and γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA) as an inhibitory neurotransmitter. Dopamine is known to act as an excitatory neurotransmitter when type 1 dopamine receptors are expressed on the postsynaptic membrane, and as an inhibitory neurotransmitter when type 2 dopamine receptors are expressed. In biological experiments investigating what effect a neurotransmitter has on the postsynaptic cell, substances called agonists, which bind to the receptor and act in the same way as the neurotransmitter, or antagonists, which weaken its action, are often used instead of the actual neurotransmitter.

In the brain, which makes up the central nervous system, many of the nerve cells of one region that release the same neurotransmitter sometimes form synapses with the nerve cells of another particular region. Experiments using rat brain preparations revealed the following.

• The nerve cells of region A form synapses with the nerve cells of region B. Similarly, regions B and D form synapses with P, and region C with B and D (Figure 13-1).

• The neurotransmitters released and the receptors expressed by the nerve cells of each region are as in Table 13-1.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/jbo-2021-2-13-fig1.png

The nerve cells of all the regions are assumed to have spontaneous activity (a certain activity even without neurotransmitters). Answer box: 33

ある神経細胞から別の神経細胞への情報伝達はシナプスと呼ばれる場所で行われる。シナプス前細胞から放出される様々な神経伝達物質は、シナプス後膜上の受容体に結合し、シナプス後細胞に興奮性あるいは抑制性シナプス後電位を生じさせる。通常、グルタミン酸やアセチルコリンは興奮性、γ-アミノ酪酸(GABA)は抑制性神経伝達物質として作用する。ドーパミンはシナプス後膜上に1型ドーパミン受容体が発現している場合には興奮性、2型ドーパミン受容体が発現している場合には抑制性神経伝達物質として作用することが知られている。神経伝達物質がシナプス後細胞にどのような影響を与えるかを調べる生物学実験においては、実際の神経伝達物質の代わりに、受容体と結合して神経伝達物質と同様に作用するアゴニスト、あるいは作用を減弱するアンタゴニストと呼ばれる物質を用いることが多い。

Flows of matter or energy are shown by solid lines with arrows, and interference relationships over space by solid lines only.

From this difference between the Japanese white birch and the sea fig, choose from A–G the most appropriate interpretation of the fact that in the Japanese white birch the amount of starch decreased and sucrose increased in winter (December to February). (5 points)

A. Because the amount of photosynthesis decreases in winter, the starch stored in the cells of the branches is broken down and converted into sucrose, which comes to be supplied as a respiratory substrate for the cells of the assimilatory organs.

B. Because the amount of photosynthesis decreases in winter, the starch stored in the cells of the branches is broken down and converted into sucrose, which comes to be supplied as a respiratory substrate for the cells of the non-assimilatory organs.

C. As the temperature falls, the supply of starch as a product of photosynthesis decreases, and at the same time the consumption of stored starch by respiration proceeds. Meanwhile, the supply of sucrose from the leaves accompanying leaf fall increased.

D. As the temperature falls, the supply of starch as a product of photosynthesis decreases, and at the same time the consumption of stored starch by respiration proceeds. Meanwhile, the supply of sucrose from the non-assimilatory organs of the root system increased.

E. As the temperature falls, stored starch is broken down into sucrose and the osmotic pressure of the cells rises. As a result, the uptake of water into the cells increases, the turgor pressure of the cells rises, and wilting of the branches due to low temperature is prevented.

F. As the temperature falls, stored starch is broken down into sucrose and the osmotic pressure of the cells rises. As a result, dehydration from the cells proceeds rapidly, and freezing inside the cells is prevented.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/jbo-2022-1-7-fig1.png

A．冬場に光合成量が低下するため，枝の細胞に貯蔵されたデンプンが分解されてショ糖に変換され，同化器官の細胞の呼吸基質として供給されるようになる。

B．冬場に光合成量が低下するため，枝の細胞に貯蔵されたデンプンが分解されてショ糖に変換され，非同化器官の細胞の呼吸基質として供給されるようになる。

C．気温の低下にともない，光合成産物としてのデンプンの供給が減ると共に，呼吸による貯蔵デンプンの消費が進む。その一方で，落葉に伴う葉からのショ糖の供給が増加した。

D．気温の低下にともない，光合成産物としてのデンプンの供給が減ると共に，呼吸による貯蔵デンプンの消費が進む。その一方で，根系の非同化器官からのショ糖の供給が増加した。

E．気温の低下にともない，貯蔵デンプンがショ糖に分解され，細胞の浸透圧が上昇する。これにより細胞内への吸水が高まり，細胞の膨圧が上昇し，低温による枝のしおれが防がれる。

F．気温の低下にともない，貯蔵デンプンがショ糖に分解され，細胞の浸透圧が上昇する。これにより細胞からの脱水が急激に進み，細胞内部の凍結が防がれる。

G．気温の低下にともない，貯蔵デンプンがショ糖に分解され，細胞の浸透圧が上昇する。これにより細胞内液の凝固点が下がり，細胞内部の凍結が防がれる。

[Experiment 1] A solution of sword-bean powder dissolved in a buffer was prepared and poured into a test tube containing 1 mL of the collected urine, and the tube was closed with a rubber stopper. To measure the amount of ammonia produced, a piece of filter paper coated with Nessler's reagent was hung from the rubber stopper, as in Figure 1.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/jbo-2022-1-11-fig1.png

[Experiment 2] A solution of sword-bean powder dissolved in a buffer was boiled for 10 minutes, and the experiment was then carried out in the same way as Experiment 1. As a result, no reddish-brown colour was seen on the piece of filter paper, showing that no ammonia was produced.

[Experiment 3] The collected blood was centrifuged and the supernatant was obtained. Using 1 mL of this supernatant instead of the urine, the experiment was carried out in the same way as Experiment 1. As a result, the reddish-brown colour was paler than in Experiment 1, and from the relationship between ammonia concentration and the intensity of the reddish-brown colour determined in advance, it was found that about 1/50 of the amount of ammonia of Experiment 1 was produced.

［実験1］ナタマメの粉末を緩衝液に溶かした溶液を作り，これを採取した尿1mLを含む試験管に注ぎ入れ，ゴム栓で栓をした。この時，発生するアンモニア量を測るため，図1のようにネスラー試薬を塗り付けたろ紙片をゴム栓に吊り下げた。

ネスラー試薬は，アンモニア量に応じた濃さで赤褐色に発色するため，あらかじめ各濃度の塩化アンモニウム溶液を準備し，ネスラー試薬と反応させ，分光濃度計をもちいて，アンモニアの濃度と赤褐色の濃淡の関係を調べておいた。

［実験2］ナタマメの粉末を緩衝液に溶かした溶液を10分間煮沸した後，実験1と同様に実験を行った。その結果，ろ紙片に赤褐色の発色はみられず，アンモニアが発生しなかったことがわかった。

［実験3］採取した血液を遠心分離器にかけて，上清をえた。この上清１mLを尿の代わりにもちいて実験1と同様に実験を行った。その結果，実験1よりも赤褐色の発色は薄く，あらかじめ求めていたアンモニア濃度と赤褐色の濃淡との関係より，実験1の約50分の1の量のアンモニアが発生したことがわかった。

problems.problem:
In Drosophila melanogaster (キイロショウジョウバエ), sex is determined not by the presence or absence of the Y chromosome but by the number of X chromosomes. An XXY fly carrying a special chromosome called an attached-X chromosome, formed by the fusion of two X chromosomes, is female, and this individual produces XX eggs and Y eggs by meiosis. Males collected in the wild were separated one by one and crossed with the above XXY females, and males and females of the next generation were obtained. Individuals with one or two X chromosomes are born, but individuals with zero or three X chromosomes die during development. Therefore the males of the next generation are all individuals carrying the X chromosome derived from the single wild male. By crossing the males and females born in this way, many lines carrying a uniform X chromosome of wild origin (X-chromosome pure lines) were established. Males of these X-chromosome pure lines were crossed with females of a certain line in an attempt to produce, two generations later, females carrying the X chromosome of wild origin in the homozygous state. In most lines the desired individuals were obtained without problems, but in one line it turned out that the homozygous females were lethal. Choose from A–L the correct combination of statements that fill the blanks ( ) in the following explanation written in connection with this. (7 points)

The X chromosome in question carries a ( ア ) lethal gene. However, because there is a gene that suppresses that lethal gene on ( イ ), its effect appears only in females. As evidence of this, when a male carrying the X chromosome in question is crossed with an attached-X female that ( ウ ), no males are born in the next generation.

problems.problem:
Recessive lethal genes, because of their harmfulness, are maintained in populations at very low frequencies. Here two models are considered: the completely recessive lethal model and the incompletely recessive lethal model. At a certain locus there are two alleles (A and a), and individuals of genotype aa cannot survive. The difference between the two models is the relative viability of the heterozygote (Aa) (see the table below).

$$\begin{array}{l|c|c|c} & & \text{Relative viability} & \\ \text{Genotype} & \text{AA} & \text{Aa} & \text{aa} \\ \hline \text{Completely recessive lethal model} & 1 & 1 & 0 \\ \text{Incompletely recessive lethal model} & 1 & 1 - h & 0 \end{array}$$

(Note) h is assumed to be in the range $0.02 < h < 0.04$

In these models, the mutation rate (per generation) at which the lethal gene a arises from the normal gene A is u, and mutation by which the lethal gene a reverts to the normal gene A does not occur. u is smaller than $10^{-5}$.

The following passage derives approximately the frequency (equilibrium frequency) of the lethal gene a maintained in a certain population. The population is assumed to be very large, with no effect of genetic drift. The frequency of the lethal gene a is q. Choose from A–L the correct combination of expressions that fill the blanks ( ) in the passage. (7 points)

In the completely recessive lethal model, the frequency of the lethal gene a increases every generation by mutation at a rate u, but decreases by natural selection at a rate ( ア ). Therefore, the equilibrium frequency of the lethal gene is ( イ ).

In the incompletely recessive lethal model, on the other hand, the frequency of the lethal gene a increases every generation by mutation at a rate u, but decreases by natural selection at a rate ( ウ ). Therefore, the equilibrium frequency of the lethal gene is ( エ ).

$$\begin{array}{l|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|c}  & \text{A} & \text{B} & \text{C} & \text{D} & \text{E} & \text{F} & \text{G} & \text{H} & \text{I} & \text{J} & \text{K} & \text{L} \\ \hline \text{ア} & q & q & q & 2q & 2q & 2q & q^2 & q^2 & q^2 & 2q^2 & 2q^2 & 2q^2 \\ \text{イ} & u & u & u & \dfrac{u}{2} & \dfrac{u}{2} & \dfrac{u}{2} & \sqrt{u} & \sqrt{u} & \sqrt{u} & \sqrt{\dfrac{u}{2}} & \sqrt{\dfrac{u}{2}} & \sqrt{\dfrac{u}{2}} \\ \text{ウ} & qh & 2qh & q^2h & qh & 2qh & q^2h & qh & 2qh & q^2h & qh & 2qh & q^2h \\ \text{エ} & \dfrac{u}{h} & \dfrac{u}{2h} & \sqrt{\dfrac{u}{h}} & \dfrac{u}{h} & \dfrac{u}{2h} & \sqrt{\dfrac{u}{h}} & \dfrac{u}{h} & \dfrac{u}{2h} & \sqrt{\dfrac{u}{h}} & \dfrac{u}{h} & \dfrac{u}{2h} & \sqrt{\dfrac{u}{h}} \end{array}$$

$$\begin{array}{l|c|c|c} & & \text{相対生存力} & \\ \text{遺伝子型} & \text{AA} & \text{Aa} & \text{aa} \\ \hline \text{完全劣性致死モデル} & 1 & 1 & 0 \\ \text{不完全劣性致死モデル} & 1 & 1 - h & 0 \end{array}$$

（注）hは$0.02 < h < 0.04$の範囲を想定する

これらのモデルでは，正常な遺伝子Aから致死遺伝子aが生じる（世代あたりの）突然変異率をuとし，致死遺伝子aが正常な遺伝子Aにもどる突然変異は生じないものとする。なお，uは$10^{-5}$より小さいものとする。

次の文章は，ある集団中に維持されている致死遺伝子aの頻度（平衡頻度）を近似的に求めたものである。なお，この集団は非常に大きく，遺伝的浮動の影響はないと仮定する。また，致死遺伝子aの頻度をqとする。文章中の（ ）内に入る記述の組合せとして正しいものをA～Lから選べ。（7点）

完全劣性致死モデルでは，致死遺伝子aの頻度は毎世代，突然変異によりuの割合で増加するが，自然選択により（ ア ）の割合で減少する。したがって，致死遺伝子の平衡頻度は（ イ ）である。

一方，不完全劣性致死モデルでは，致死遺伝子aの頻度は毎世代，突然変異によりuの割合で増加するが，自然選択により（ ウ ）の割合で減少する。したがって，致死遺伝子の平衡頻度は（ エ ）である。

(10 points)

Of the three reaction temperatures set in ordinary PCR, if the primers are such that annealing occurs even at a sufficiently high temperature, the temperature setting can be reduced to two steps by making the annealing and extension temperatures the same.

On the other hand, the optimum annealing temperature in PCR is set with reference to the temperature at which the template DNA and the primers are equally in an equilibrium of dissociation and association. That is, even without passing through a temperature at which double-stranded DNA is completely denatured, at a temperature at which annealing could theoretically occur the double-helix structure of the template DNA is in an equilibrium of dissociation and association, and annealing of the template DNA and a primer can occur there in such a way that the primer takes the place of one of the DNA strands.

Considering these points, the possibility arises that in an artificial DNA amplification reaction even the heat-denaturation step of DNA could be eliminated and the whole temperature setting fixed at a single step. However, when the DNA polymerase has the property shown in Figure 3-1 (A), even if a primer binds to the template DNA, the DNA extension reaction does not proceed when a strand that blocks the DNA extension reaction is already bound ahead of it (that is, as in the heat-denaturation step of PCR, the DNA extension reaction does not proceed unless there is a step in which the DNA clearly becomes single-stranded). On the other hand, with a DNA polymerase with the property of Figure 3-1 (B), the DNA extension reaction continues while the DNA strand already present is dissociated. A DNA polymerase with the property of Figure 3-1 (B) is called a strand-displacing DNA polymerase, but most of the DNA polymerases used in ordinary PCR have the property of Figure 3-1 (A).

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/jbo-2022-2-3-fig1.png

Figure labels (Japanese → English): DNA伸長反応 = DNA extension reaction; 伸長先に既にDNA鎖があるとき = when a DNA strand is already present ahead of the extension; (A) DNA伸長反応が止まる = (A) the DNA extension reaction stops; (B) 既にあるDNAを解離させながら伸長する = (B) extends while dissociating the DNA already present.

Figure 3-1. Two kinds of DNA polymerase. (A) A DNA polymerase with the property that the DNA extension reaction stops when a DNA strand is already present ahead of the extension. (B) A DNA polymerase with the property that the extension reaction proceeds while the DNA strand already present ahead of the extension is dissociated. Figure modified from the Wikimedia Commons file "Rolling_circle.svg".

Also, depending on the sequence of the primer, a state in which the template DNA and the primer anneal partially, as in Figure 3-2, can also occur.

(10点)

一般的なPCRで設定する三段階の反応温度において、十分高い温度でもアニーリングが起こるプライマーであれば、アニーリングと伸長反応の温度を一致させることで温度設定を二段階に減らすことができる。

また一方で、PCRで最適なアニーリング温度を設定するには、鋳型DNAとプライマー同士が等しく解離と会合の平衡状態となる温度が基準となっている。つまり、二本鎖DNAが完全に変性する温度を経ずとも、理論的にはアニーリングが起こるような温度で鋳型DNAの二重らせん構造が解離と会合の平衡状態となり、そこで片方のDNA鎖とすり替わるような形で鋳型DNAとプライマーのアニーリングが起こりうる。

これらのことを踏まえると、人工的なDNA増幅反応においてDNA熱変性の段階さえ減らし、全体の温度設定を一段階のみに固定出来る可能性が生じる。ただし、DNAポリメラーゼが図3-1 (A)に示すような性質のときには、仮にプライマーが鋳型DNAに結合しても、その先にDNA伸長反応を妨げる鎖が既に結合している状態では、DNA伸長反応が進まない（つまり、PCRにおけるDNA熱変性の段階のように、DNAが明らかに一本鎖となる段階を経ないとDNA伸長反応が進まない）。一方で3-1 (B)の性質のDNAポリメラーゼでは、既に存在するDNA鎖を解離させながらDNA伸長反応が続行する。この図3-1 (B)のような性質のDNAポリメラーゼを鎖置換型DNAポリメラーゼと呼ぶが、一般的なPCRで用いられるDNAポリメラーゼのほとんどは図3-1 (A)の性質のものである。

problems.problem:
(8 points)

In a biological population, the change of allele frequencies over generations through the effect of random sampling is called genetic drift. In particular, when a new population is formed from a very small number of individuals, gene frequencies may change greatly from those of the original population through genetic drift; this is called the founder effect.

With the dramatic progress of genome science in recent years, two important findings have become clear about the relationship between genetic diversity and geographical distribution in human populations. The first is that the farther a population is from Africa, the lower its genetic diversity. The second is that the farther a population is from Africa, the more harmful mutations it has accumulated. These trends are thought to reflect the effects of genetic drift and natural selection arising in the process of the migration of human populations. With this in mind, answer Questions 1 and 2 below.

Question 1

Of the following sentences (1)–(6) about genetic diversity and genetic drift, choose all the correct ones and mark the numbers of all the chosen options in the answer box. If you judge that all the statements are correct, mark only (9); if you judge that there is no correct statement, mark only (0). Answer box: 23

(1) In general, genetic drift increases the genetic diversity within a population.

(2) Through immigration from various populations, the genetic diversity of the African population increased.

(3) Humans spread from Africa throughout the world, and in that process the founder effect occurred repeatedly.

(4) The farther a population is from Africa, the lower the frequency of heterozygous individuals.

(5) The frequencies of heterozygotes and homozygotes are unrelated to genetic diversity.

(6) The frequency of ancestral alleles, taking the closely related species the chimpanzee as reference, is higher in Asian populations than in African populations.

Question 2

Of the following sentences (1)–(6) about natural selection and genetic drift, choose all the correct ones and mark the numbers of all the chosen options in the answer box. If you judge that all the statements are correct, mark only (9); if you judge that there is no correct statement, mark only (0). Answer box: 24

(1) In a small population rather than a large population, natural selection acts effectively, so that harmful mutations are more easily removed.

(2) (Deleted)

(3) Through immigration and emigration with various populations, harmful mutations accumulated less easily in the African population.

(4) The reason why the farther a population is from Africa, the more harmful mutations it has accumulated is that natural selection does not act effectively in small populations.

(5) It is thought that the farther a population is from Africa, the more it carries harmful mutations in the homozygous state, so that their effects appear more readily.

(6) Hardy–Weinberg equilibrium assumes that mutations are supplied sufficiently, and therefore it cannot be applied to populations in which the founder effect occurs.
problems.problem_orig:
(8点)

生物集団において、無作為抽出の効果によって対立遺伝子頻度が世代を経て変化していくことを遺伝的浮動と呼ぶ。とくに、ごく少数の個体から新しい集団が形成されるときに、遺伝的浮動により遺伝子頻度が元の集団から大きく変化することがあり、これを創始者効果と呼ぶ。

近年のゲノム科学の飛躍的進展から、ヒト集団における遺伝的多様性と地理的分布との関係について、ふたつの重要な知見が明らかになってきた。1点目は、アフリカからの距離が遠い集団ほど遺伝的多様性が低いということである。2点目は、アフリカからの距離が遠い集団ほど、有害な突然変異を多く蓄積しているということである。これらの傾向は、ヒト集団の移住の過程で生じる遺伝的浮動と自然選択の影響を反映していると考えられる。この点を踏まえ、以下の問1・問2に答えなさい。

問1

遺伝的多様性と遺伝的浮動に関する以下の文(1)-(6)について、正しいものをすべて選び、選んだ選択肢の番号をすべて解答欄にマークしなさい。なお、すべての記述が正しいと判断した場合は(9)だけをマークし、正しい記述が無いと判断した場合は(0)だけをマークしなさい。解答欄は　23

(1) 一般に、遺伝的浮動は集団内の遺伝的多様性を増加させる

(2) 様々な集団からの移入により、アフリカ集団の遺伝的多様性が高まった

(3) ヒトはアフリカから世界中に拡散し、その過程で繰り返し創始者効果が起きてきた

(4) アフリカからの距離が遠い集団ほど、ヘテロ接合個体の頻度は減少する

(5) ヘテロ接合・ホモ接合の頻度と遺伝的多様性は関係がない

(6) 近縁種であるチンパンジーを基準に考えたときの祖先型対立遺伝子の頻度は、アフリカ集団よりもアジア集団の方が高い

問2

自然選択と遺伝的浮動に関する以下の文(1)-(6)について、正しいものをすべて選び、選んだ選択肢の番号をすべて解答欄にマークしなさい。なお、すべての記述が正しいと判断した場合は(9)だけをマークし、正しい記述が無いと判断した場合は(0)だけをマークしなさい。解答欄は　24

(1) 大集団より小集団のほうが、自然選択が有効に働くことで有害な突然変異が除去されやすい

(2) 削除

(3) 様々な集団との移入・移出により、アフリカ集団では有害な突然変異が蓄積しにくかった

(4) アフリカからの距離が遠い集団ほど有害な突然変異を多く蓄積しているのは、小集団では自然選択が有効に働かないのが理由である

(5) アフリカから距離の遠い集団ほど有害な突然変異をホモ接合でもち、効果がより現れやすいと考えられる

(6) ハーディー・ワインベルグ平衡は、突然変異が十分に供給されることを仮定しているので、創始者効果が起きるような集団には適用できない

頂芽の存在する植物の地上部では、頂芽が腋芽の発達を抑制する頂芽優勢がみられる。頂芽優勢はオーキシン、サイトカイニン、ストリゴラクトンという三つの植物ホルモンと糖によって制御されている。シロイヌナズナにおける頂芽優勢に対するストリゴラクトンのはたらきを調べるために、カロテノイドからストリゴラクトンを合成する過程ではたらく酵素A、酵素B、酵素Cそれぞれの機能が失われ、同程度に頂芽優勢が打破された形質を示す突然変異体（以下、それぞれ変異体a、変異体b、変異体cとする）および、酵素A・酵素B・酵素Cすべての機能が失われた突然変異体（以下、三重変異体tとする）を用いて次の実験1を行った。なお、三重変異体tにおける腋芽の数は、変異体a、変異体b、変異体cのいずれとも差は無いものとする。

実験1：野生型、変異体a、変異体b、変異体c、三重変異体tの根に対して、野生型および変異体a、変異体b、変異体c、三重変異体tの地上部を接ぎ木し、生育させた地上部の形態を比較したところ、表6-1の結果が得られた。

problems.problem:
(7 points)

In the seedlings of cucurbit plants such as cucumber and melon, a protrusion called a peg is formed in the transition zone between the hypocotyl and the root (Figure 7-1 a). The seeds of these plants are flat in shape, and on the ground one peg is formed on the lower side with respect to the direction of gravity. This peg helps the cotyledons to slip out of the seed coat. To investigate the mechanism by which only one peg is formed, the following Experiments 1 to 3 were carried out.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/jbo-2022-2-7-fig1.png

Figure labels (Japanese → English): 種皮 = seed coat; 子葉 = cotyledon; 根 = root; 重力方向 = direction of gravity.

Figure 7-1. Side views of a cucumber seedling germinated under terrestrial gravity without any treatment (a), and of a cucumber seedling germinated with auxin treatment or with treatment with an inhibitor of polar auxin transport (b). The black arrows indicate the pegs, and the open arrow indicates the direction of gravity.

Experiment 1: Under terrestrial gravity, when the transition zone of cucumbers just after germination was treated with auxin, two pegs were formed as in Figure 7-1 b.

Experiment 2: Under terrestrial gravity, when the transition zone of cucumbers just after germination was treated with an inhibitor of polar auxin transport (polar movement), two pegs were formed as in Figure 7-1 b.

Experiment 3: When cucumber seeds were germinated in a microgravity environment such as outer space, two pegs were formed as in Figure 7-1 b.

Question 1

Choose all the appropriate conclusions that can be drawn from the results of Experiments 1 to 3 from options (1)–(7) below, and mark the numbers of all the chosen options in the answer box. If you judge that there is no appropriate statement, mark only (0). Answer box: 39

(1) Polar auxin transport promotes the formation of a peg on the lower side of the transition zone.

(2) Polar auxin transport suppresses the formation of a peg on the upper side of the transition zone.

(3) In seedlings germinated under terrestrial gravity, the auxin concentration in the cells on the upper side of the transition zone is higher than in the cells on the lower side.

(4) In seedlings germinated under terrestrial gravity, the auxin concentration in the cells on the upper side of the transition zone is lower than in the cells on the lower side.

(5) There is no difference in auxin concentration between the cells on the upper side and on the lower side of the transition zone.

(6) The response to the direction of gravity promotes the formation of a peg on the lower side of the transition zone.

(7) The response to the direction of gravity suppresses the formation of a peg on the upper side of the transition zone.

Question 2

On the basis of the results of Experiments 1 to 3, what experiment should be carried out when trying to produce experimentally a seedling in which no peg is formed? Choose all the statements about experiments considered appropriate from options (1)–(4) below, and mark the numbers of all the chosen options in the answer box. If you judge that all the statements are appropriate, mark only (9); if you judge that there is no appropriate statement, mark only (0). Answer box: 40

(1) Treat the whole transition zone with an inhibitor of the auxin response.

(2) Treat only the lower side of the transition zone with auxin at a lower concentration than that used in Experiment 1.

(3) Treat only the lower side of the transition zone with an inhibitor of polar auxin transport at a lower concentration than that used in Experiment 1.

(4) Grow the seedlings in a hypergravity environment produced by a centrifuge, so that hypergravity is applied in the downward direction.

キュウリ、メロンなどのウリ科植物の芽生えでは、胚軸と根の境界領域にペグと呼ばれる突起が形成される（図7-1 a）。これらの植物の種子は扁平な形をしており、地上において、ペグは重力方向下側にひとつ形成される。このペグは、子葉が種皮から抜け出るのに役立っている。ペグがひとつだけ形成されるしくみを調べるため、次の実験1から3を行った。

実験2：地上重力下で、発芽直後のキュウリの境界領域にオーキシン極性輸送（極性移動）の阻害剤を処理したところ、ペグは図7-1 bのようにふたつ形成された。

実験3：宇宙空間などの微小重力環境でキュウリ種子を発芽させたところ、ペグは図7-1 bのようにふたつ形成された。

問1

実験1から3の結果から考えられることとして適切なものを下の選択肢(1)-(7)よりすべて選び、選んだ選択肢の番号をすべて解答欄にマークしなさい。なお、適切な記述が無いと判断した場合は(0)だけをマークしなさい。解答欄は　39

(1) オーキシンの極性輸送は境界領域下側へのペグの形成を促進する

(2) オーキシンの極性輸送は境界領域上側へのペグの形成を抑制する

(3) 地上重力下で発芽させた芽生えにおける境界領域上側の細胞におけるオーキシン濃度は下側の細胞より高い

(4) 地上重力下で発芽させた芽生えにおける境界領域上側の細胞におけるオーキシン濃度は下側の細胞より低い

(5) 境界領域上側と下側の細胞では、オーキシン濃度に差はない

(6) 重力方向への応答は、境界領域下側へのペグの形成を促進する

(7) 重力方向への応答は、境界領域上側へのペグの形成を抑制する

問2

実験1から3の結果を踏まえ、実験的にペグが形成されない芽生えを作成しようとしたとき、どのような実験を行えばよいと考えられるか。適切と考えられる実験についての記述を下の選択肢(1)-(4)よりすべて選び、選んだ選択肢の番号をすべて解答欄にマークしなさい。なお、すべての記述が適切だと判断した場合は(9)だけをマークし、適切な記述が無いと判断した場合は(0)だけをマークしなさい。解答欄は　40

(1) 境界領域全体に対してオーキシン応答の阻害剤を処理する

(2) 境界領域の下側だけに、実験1で用いた濃度より薄い濃度でオーキシンを処理する

(3) 境界領域の下側だけに、実験1で用いた濃度より薄い濃度でオーキシン極性輸送阻害剤を処理する

(4) 下方向に過重力が付加されるように遠心機による過重力環境で芽生えを育成する

(8点)

酸素（O$_2$）は呼吸に使われる一方で、他の反応を阻害することがある。光合成生物における、酸素による活性阻害に関する以下の問いに答えなさい。

問1

窒素固定反応を担う酵素であるニトロゲナーゼは、O$_2$存在下では失活してしまうため、O$_2$のある環境では窒素固定反応が進まない。アナベナ属のシアノバクテリアでは、細胞が数珠状に連なっており、そのほとんどの細胞（栄養細胞）で光合成を行うため、O$_2$が発生する。しかし、環境中に窒素源が欠乏すると、その一部をヘテロシストと呼ばれる細胞へと分化させ、窒素固定反応を行なう。つまり、空間的に窒素固定の場とO$_2$を分けている。アナベナ属のシアノバクテリアが光合成と窒素固定を両立させている仕組みの記述として間違っていると判断されるものを下の選択肢(1)-(5)よりすべて選び、選んだ選択肢の番号をすべて解答欄にマークしなさい。なお、すべての記述が間違っていると判断した場合は(9)だけをマークし、すべての記述が間違っていないと判断した場合は(0)だけをマークしなさい。解答欄は　41

(1) ヘテロシストの外側にバリア層を形成し、外からの酸素の流入を防ぐ

(2) ヘテロシスト内の呼吸活性を上昇させ、酸素を消費する

(3) 栄養細胞の光合成を抑制し、酸素の発生を抑える

(4) ヘテロシスト内の光合成を抑制し、酸素の発生を抑える

(5) 光の届かないところで生育し、窒素固定を行う

問2

光合成ではRubiscoと呼ばれる酵素によって炭酸固定反応が行われるが、Rubiscoは二酸化炭素（CO$_2$）だけでなく、一定の割合でO$_2$も基質としてしまい、光合成の効率が低下する。そのため、相対的に環境中のCO$_2$濃度が低く、O$_2$濃度が高い場合、CO$_2$に代わって多くのO$_2$を取り込んでしまう。図8-1は現在の大気圧で、あるC3植物の光合成速度（CO$_2$吸収速度）と光強度の関係を示している。もし、CO$_2$濃度が上昇した場合、このグラフはどのように変化すると考えられるか、図8-2の選択肢(1)-(6)から選び、解答欄にマークしなさい。ただし、O$_2$濃度は変わらないものとする。解答欄は　42
